issues.explanation: Chapter 30 establishes that 高览 has defected to曹操 and been封赏. Chapter 31 then presents 高览 as a袁绍将领 commanding a rear force and has赵云 kill him, contradicting his established identity and allegiance.
issues.suggested_fix: Clarify that this is another similarly named officer, or revise one chapter so 高览 does not defect in Chapter 30 / does not appear as a袁军将领 in Chapter 31.
